Name: Make Your Bed
Author: xiddav
Description:
Every day one of the several random colors for sheets, blanket,  pillows and pillow stripes in your farmhouse and cabins will mesh together to make you single bed, double bed, child beds and crib something neat.
Or you can change the config settings and pick your favorite ones that don't change.

Cabins all match, but Farmhouse is different

[size=4]
[/size][font=Lucida Sans Unicode][size=6]Customization Options. 
[/size]I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu[/b][/url] for easy of customization in game.
[size=1][spoiler][/size]
[/font][b][color=#f4cccc][size=4]SameDoublePillow[/size][size=3]:[/size][/color][/b] true or false
﻿When true the pillows on the double size bed will match each other.
﻿If false they will most likely not patch each other.

[b][color=#ead1dc][size=4]PillowStrip[/size][size=3]:[/size][/color][/b] true or false
﻿effects random only. Strips not available for customization. ﻿
﻿True: you will have random strips on pillows everyday (there's a blank one so not Everyday).
﻿False, no strips at all.

[size=4][b][color=#ead1dc]RandomFarmSheet[/color][/b] and[b] [/b][color=#ead1dc][b]RandomCabinSheet[/b]:[/color][/size] true or false
